1.text: Twebwe abakomeye dukwiriye kwihanganira intege nke z'abadakomeye, ntitwinezeze.

2.text: Umuntu wese muri twe anezeze mugenzi we kugira ngo amubere inyunganizi amukomeze,

3.text: kuko Kristo na we atinejeje nk'uko byanditswe ngo “Ibitutsi bagututse byangezeho.”

4.text: Ibyanditswe kera byose byandikiwe kutwigisha, kugira ngo kwihangana no guhumurizwa bitangwa na byo biduheshe ibyiringiro.

5.text: Nuko rero Imana nyir'ukwihangana no guhumurizwa ibahe guhuza imitima yanyu nk'uko Kristo Yesu ashaka,

6.text: kugira ngo muhimbaze Imana y'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo ari yo na Se, n'umutima umwe n'akanwa kamwe.

7.text: Nuko mwemerane nk'uko Kristo na we yabemeye, kugira ngo Imana ihimbazwe.

8.text: Ndavuga yuko Kristo yabaye umukozi w'abakebwe wo kubagaburira iby'Imana ku bw'ukuri kwayo, kugira ngo asohoze ibyo ba sogokuruza basezeranijwe,

9.text: kandi ngo abanyamahanga bahimbarize Imana imbabazi zayo nk'uko byanditswe ngo“Nzavuga ishimwe ryawe mu mahanga,Kandi nzaririmbira izina ryawe.”

10.text: Kandi ngo“Banyamahanga mwese mwe, mwishimane n'ubwoko bwayo.”

11.text: Kandi ngo“Banyamahanga mwese mwe, mushime Uwiteka,Kandi amoko yose amuhimbaze.”

12.text: Yesaya na we yarabisongeye ati“Hazabaho igitsina cya Yesayi,Ni we uzahaguruka gutwara abanyamahanga,Ni na we abanyamahanga baziringira.”

13.text: Imana nyir'ibyiringiro ibuzuze umunezero wose n'amahoro biheshwa no kwizera, kugira ngo murusheho kwiringira mubiheshejwe n'imbaraga z'Umwuka Wera.

14.text: Bene Data, nanjye nzi neza ibyanyu yuko mwuzuye ingeso nziza, mwuzuye n'ubwenge bwose mukaba mwashobora no guhugurana.

15.text: Nyamara muri uru rwandiko hamwe na hamwe nabandikiye ntabobera, nsa n'ubibutsa ku bw'ubuntu nahawe n'Imana,

16.text: yuko nkwiriye kuba umukozi wa Yesu Kristo mu banyamahanga, wo kubagaburira ubutumwa bwiza bw'Imana nk'umutambyi, kugira ngo abanyamahanga babone uko baba igitambo gishimwa cyejejwe n'Umwuka Wera.

17.text: Ni cyo gituma niyogeza mu murimo nkorera Imana muri Yesu Kristo.

18.text: Sinzatinyuka kugira icyo mvuga, keretse icyo nakoreshejwe na Kristo ngo abanyamahanga bumvire Imana.

19.text: Yampaye amagambo n'imirimo, n'imbaraga z'ibimenyetso bikomeye, n'ibitangaza n'imbaraga z'Umwuka Wera. Ibyo byatumye nsohoza ubutumwa bwiza bwa Kristo, uhereye i Yerusalemu, ukazenguruka ukagera muri Iluriko.

20.text: Kandi nashishikariraga kuvuga ubutumwa bwiza aho izina rya Kristo ritari ryamenywa, ngo ntubaka ku rufatiro rwubatswe n'undi,

21.text: ahubwo ngo bimere nk'uko byanditswe ngo“Abatabwiwe ibye bazabibona,Kandi abatabyumvise bazabimenya.”

22.text: Ni cyo cyatumye ngira igisībya kenshi kimbuza kuza iwanyu,

23.text: ariko none ubwo ntagifite aho nshigaje muri ibi bihugu, nkaba narahereye mu myaka myinshi nifuza kuza iwanyu,

24.text: ubwo nzajya i Sipaniya niringira kuzabasura nimpanyura, kugira ngo namwe mubone uko mumperekeza, njyeyo maze kubashira urukumbuzi ho hato.

25.text: Ariko none ndajya i Yerusalemu kugaburira abera,

26.text: kuko ab'i Makedoniya na Akaya bashimye gusonzoraniriza impiya abakene bo mu bera b'i Yerusalemu.

27.text: Bashimye kuzibaha kandi babafitiye umwenda, kuko ubwo abanyamahanga basangiye iby'umwuka byabo, bafite umwenda wo kubafasha ku by'umubiri.

28.text: Nindangiza ibyo maze kubashyikiriza neza izo mbuto z'ubuntu, nzavayo nyure iwanyu njye i Sipaniya.

29.text: Kandi nzi yuko ubwo nzaza aho muri, nzazana umugisha wa Kristo ugwiriye.

30.text: Nuko ndabinginga bene Data, ku bw'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo, no ku bw'urukundo ruva ku Mwuka, ngo mushishikarane nanjye kunsabira Imana

31.text: nkire ab'i Yudaya batanyumvira, kandi kugira ngo imfashanyo njyana i Yerusalemu zishimwe n'abera

32.text: mbone uko nza aho muri nishimye, Imana nibikunda nduhukane namwe.

33.text: Imana nyir'amahoro ibane namwe mwese, Amen.
